# Andres, Berger & Tran

> A New Jersey medical malpractice and personal injury law firm specializing in birth injury claims and healthcare negligence litigation across South Jersey.

Andres, Berger & Tran is a Camden County-based law firm with over 70 years of combined trial experience representing victims of medical malpractice, birth injuries, and healthcare negligence throughout New Jersey. The firm focuses on complex cases involving anesthesia errors, obstetric complications, and neonatal brain injuries.

- Medical Malpractice
- Birth Injury Claims
- Cerebral Palsy
- Erb's Palsy
- Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)
- Healthcare Negligence
- New Jersey Law
- Camden County
- South Jersey
- Haddonfield
- Personal Injury Law
- Anesthesia Errors
- Obstetric Negligence
